MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 44

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 6
   C. 11
   D. 17

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 22

7. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 1

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 25

12. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 1

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

17. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

18. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

19. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

22. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

23. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

24. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
